# Draft:36th Sarasaviya Awards

The 36th Sarasaviya Awards festival (), presented by the Associated Newspapers of Ceylon Limited, the awards ceremony to honour the best films of 2023 in Sinhala cinema will be held on 24 June 2025 at the BMICH, Colombo.
